title: What a Godly Man Does With Advent (It's Not a Countdown)
caption:
Advent starts Sunday.

Most of us treat December like a countdown. Shopping, parties, a few days off, then it's over. But the church has always used these four weeks for something else: waiting on purpose.

Israel waited centuries. John cleared the road. God came small, in a feeding trough, to a town with no room. And He told His men to stay awake, because He's coming back.

So pick one thing you're waiting on Him for. Pick one thing to clear out. Take the low seat. Keep watch.

"What I say to you I say to all: Stay awake." Mark 13:37

Save this for Sunday. Send it to the brother you're walking through December with.
